simple.summary: בֶּזֶק (Bezeq) means Bezek , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Sam 11 8.

definitions.full: H966. Bezeq בֶּ֫זֶקִ proper name, of a location 1Sam 11:8 ( בְּבָ֑זֶק ) rendezvous of Israel under Saul and Samuel; Judg 1:4-5 , home of Adoni-bezek; on location compare Euseb. Lag Onom. 105, 2nd ed. 139 ; see also Stu. 1:4 ; Judges 17th (mile-)stone from Neapolis toward Scythopolis; modern –irbet Ibzî‡ , 14 English miles from Nâblus, Survey ii. 231 . **Nes AJSL xiii {1897}. 176 conjectures meaning gravel , compare modern Ramle = sand. **Error in 1:4-5 , (see GFM).
